steps: Editor registers a validated experiment entry.
Editor submits the entry for policy and teacher review.
Reviewer approves the entry and the service publishes it.
Archive operator closes the approved entry in the edition.
Reader or editor searches by edition or text.
Editor updates a draft or rejected entry.
API or query service returns the visible published entry.
Importer validates required fields and experiment steps.
Registry and bbolt persist accepted records.
Reporter counts archived and visible entries for the edition.
